facts.text: Built QueueKit, a Postgres-backed job queue, because the college fest app lost registration emails when its mail provider timed out
QueueKit sustained 300 jobs per second with four workers in a local load test, using SKIP LOCKED row claiming
Lost fest registration emails fell from about 40 to zero in the 2026 registration week after retries and a dead-letter table
Built CampusBites, a canteen pre-order API that replaced paper tokens at the hostel canteen
CampusBites served 1,200 orders in its first month with p95 response under 120 ms
CampusBites has 35 integration tests run on every push in GitHub Actions
Web Team Lead, Coding Club, Aug 2024 to May 2025; ran weekly backend workshops for 40 juniors

bullets.text: Built a Postgres-backed job queue for a college fest app that lost registration emails whenever its mail provider timed out during peak signups.
Used SKIP LOCKED row claiming so four workers process jobs without double delivery, sustaining 300 jobs per second in a local load test.
Added exponential retry with a dead-letter table, cutting lost emails in the 2026 fest registration week from about 40 to zero.
Replaced the paper token system at the hostel canteen with a pre-order API, so students stop queueing through the lunch rush.
Cached the daily menu in Redis and served 1,200 orders in the first month with p95 response times under 120 ms.
Wrote 35 integration tests covering ordering, cancellation and stock limits, running on every push through GitHub Actions.
